quick_reference.critical_instruction:
When user asks to "show me an example [platform] definition", "use the request MCP", or "grab the platform definition", follow this process:
1. Identify the platform name from user's request 2. Look up the platform_id in the section below 3. IMMEDIATELY call techzone-get-platform with that platform_id 4. DO NOT search documentation first - retrieve the platform directly 5. Use the bearerToken from environment (retrieved via token skill)

overview.description: This reference provides mappings between IBM Technology Zone platforms and their corresponding platform IDs for retrieving example environment definitions via techzone-request-mcp. These mappings are essential for the how-to question workflow when examples are needed.
overview.usage: Use these platform IDs with techzone-request-mcp to fetch example environment definitions that demonstrate proper structure and configuration for each platform.
overview.critical_reminder: When displaying information from retrieved environment definitions, NEVER show sensitive information such as API keys, deploy keys, account IDs, or user identifiers. Platform IDs are internal identifiers - don't include them in user-facing responses.

guideline.name: Filter Sensitive Information
guideline.description: When retrieving and displaying information from example environment definitions, you MUST filter out all sensitive information before showing it to the user.
guideline.replacement_strategy: Replace sensitive values with placeholders like: - [API_KEY] or [REDACTED] - [DEPLOY_KEY] or [REDACTED] - [ACCOUNT_ID] or [REDACTED] - [USER_ID] or [REDACTED]

guideline.name: Extract Relevant Portions Only
guideline.description: Don't display the entire environment definition. Extract and show only the portions relevant to answering the user's question.

examples.example: If user asks about post-deploy variables, show only the post_deploy_variables section with sensitive data filtered.
If user asks about manifest structure, show only the manifest section with service names and structure, not the entire definition.

guideline.name: Explain the Structure
guideline.description: When showing examples, explain what each part does and how it fits into the overall environment definition.

guideline.name: Reference Documentation
guideline.description: Always reference the official documentation alongside examples to provide complete context.

retrieval_workflow.critical_rule: When user explicitly asks to "use the request MCP", "show me an example [platform]", or "grab the platform definition", skip documentation searches and go DIRECTLY to fetching the platform using the platform_id from the section.

step.title: Identify Platform
step.description: Determine which platform the user is asking about.

examples.example: User says "watsonx SaaS Shared" → platform_name = "watsonx SaaS Shared"

step.title: Look Up Platform ID
step.description: Find the platform_id in the section of this file. Each mapping has a element containing the ID to use.
step.example: For "watsonx SaaS Shared", find the mapping and extract: 698df695447389112f155cea

step.title: Fetch Example Using techzone-get-platform
step.description: Use techzone-request-mcp with techzone-get-platform tool and the platform_id. Include bearerToken retrieved from environment.

required_parameters.bearerToken: Retrieved from environment via token skill

step.title: Present Information

rule.condition: User asks about VM deployments without specifying platform
rule.recommendation: Recommend OCPV as primary option, mention VPC as alternative
rule.rationale: OCPV is the preferred platform for VM deployments in IBM Technology Zone

rule.condition: User asks about Multi-VM without specifying OS combination
rule.recommendation: Ask if they need mixed OS (Windows + RHEL) or same OS (RHEL + RHEL)

rule.condition: User asks about IBM Cloud services
rule.recommendation: Determine if they need shared services (watsonx SaaS) or dedicated account (Account Vending)

maintenance_notes.note: These platform IDs are current as of the mode creation. If platform IDs change or new platforms are added, this reference should be updated.
Always verify that the retrieved example is current and matches the expected platform before using it to answer questions.
If a platform ID returns an error or unexpected data, inform the user and rely on documentation instead of examples.
